notes.title: ”Pumpkin Game” Ver. 3 is released with new game modes!
notes.content:
New additions

"Freeze Mode" has been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707728/34358604ba46bed748596aeac3ccbc91f59eb4fa.png
A great cold wave has arrived and baskets and vegetables have frozen!
Playing in slippery conditions is unpredictable and fun.


Changes and Corrections


 Adjusted the behavior of vegetables and scarecrows.
 Changed the size of vegetables.

notes.title: Ver 2.1.1 Changes and Corrections
notes.content:
[h2Changes and Corrections

 Changed the display of the best score to show the first place of the overall score in normal mode and the first place of the time limit score in time limit mode.
 Adjusted the behavior of vegetables and scarecrows.
 Changed the size of vegetables.
 Bug fixes.

notes.title: Changes and Corrections
notes.content:
Changes and Corrections


 Sound and animation are now played when the scarecrow comes in contact with a vegetable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707728/03cc7108c6ca7ea90c67a4207cd0e2c978cce05d.jpg
 Adjusted the behavior of vegetables and scarecrows.
 Added higher resolution than Full HD.
 Changed to allow full-screen and full-screen window display when the resolution aspect ratio is 16:9.
 Fixed a bug that vegetables were dropped when the buttons for switching ranking or switching the display of evolution chart were pressed when the left mouse click was allowed to drop vegetables.

notes.title: Version 2 is now available!
notes.content:
New additions


 "Time Limit Mode" has been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707728/387c44b2ed33b51139842c4db4aa191e919dc640.jpg
In this mode, players aim for a high score within a set time limit.
The remaining time increases when you make a pumpkin or exceed a certain score.
 1 achievement added. The total number of achievements is now 20.
 A feature that displays the name of the vegetable in a pop-up window when the mouse cursor is hovered over the vegetable in the evolution chart.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707728/291d10f224549d6678ca39ac37f2c22a470c1eee.jpg



Changes and Corrections


 Adjusted the behavior of vegetables and scarecrows.
 Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being completed.
 Displayed a confirmation screen when retry or return to title is selected.
 Changed the action to drop vegetables with the left mouse click. (can be turned on/off from the options)
